zh.title: 旧版 app 打不开 Station 和设置页
zh.body: #4108 把 station 上报的 emberRssBytes 改名成 stationRssBytes。旧版 app 还要求旧字段，workspace 里只要有一台更新过的 station，Stations 列表就解码失败，Station 页报错，设置页也刷不出来。修复 #4137 已合并：station 同时发两个名字。更新 app，或把 station 更新到带修复的版本后恢复。

en.title: Older apps could not open Stations and Settings
en.body: #4108 renamed a field stations report, emberRssBytes, to stationRssBytes. Older apps still require the old name, so one updated station in a workspace made the Stations list fail to decode, with errors on the Stations page and Settings not loading. The fix, #4137, is merged: stations send both names. Updating the app, or the station to a build with the fix, restores it.
